sentences.en: The Nazis were as socialist as North Korea is democratic.
sentences.zh: 纳粹和朝鲜一样社会主义。

sentences.en: Helen Keller was a socialist, antimilitarist, and disability rights activist.
sentences.zh: 海伦·凯勒是一位社会主义者、反军国主义者以及残疾人权利活动家。

sentences.en: Older Jewish socialists consider McCarthyism to have been a pogrom.
sentences.zh: 老一辈的犹太社会主义者认为麦卡锡主义是一场针对犹太人的迫害。
